reborn-1744.rationale: The legacy English TCG text says to 'select' 1 opponent monster, which is ambiguous about who chooses and predates modern PSCT. The official Japanese Neuron card text and Q&A explicitly state that the opponent chooses 1 monster they control during resolution, that the effect does not target, that it mandatorily activates when a face-up Spirit monster returns from the Monster Zone to the controller's hand, and that this triggered effect can activate during the Damage Step. The exact pinned Lua implements a forced EVENT_TO_HAND trigger, verifies a previously face-up Spirit returned from the Monster Zone to the controller's hand, uses Duel.SelectMatchingCard with 1-tp so the opponent chooses at resolution, and does not mark the effect as CARD_TARGET. Its Standby Phase handling also implements the 500 LP maintenance choice or destruction. The executable implementation therefore matches the authoritative current OCG ruling behavior despite stale English wording.

note: Script-hash-bound review using official Japanese Neuron text/Q&A to resolve stale English wording for Spirit's Invitation.
